svg.aria-label: Placing the positive case and bottom electrode: set the positive case open side up on a clean insulating mat and use tweezers to place the bottom spacer in its center, concentric when viewed from above. For a Li symmetric cell, first press a Li foil onto the bottom spacer, Li side up; for an SS | Li cell, place only the spacer at the bottom.
